parsed.rationale: A 6-month-old with low-grade fever (100.9°F), fussiness, decreased feeding, and fewer wet diapers needs same-day pediatric evaluation for possible infection and early dehydration. No red flags for immediate emergency (e.g., lethargy/unresponsiveness, breathing difficulty, no wet diapers for 8+ hours, seizure, non-blanching rash, or age under 3 months) are described.
